comment: Isolated MSDF Radar Display. Two data sources only: the Scenario Export files (read-only: ownship, radar poses, scan schedule, sensor properties, truth target trajectories) and the RDP SystemTrack UDP stream (receive-only). Sensor parameters are read from the export at start-up, not stored here. Every path here is relative to the project folder, so this file stays valid wherever the project is copied; an absolute path is also accepted. The Scenario Export can be overridden with --export PATH or the MSDF_SCENARIO_EXPORT environment variable.

scenario_export.comment: root: relative to the project folder (portable) or absolute. If it does not exist, the application looks in data/Scenario_Export, ../Scenario_Export, Scenario_Export and sample_data/Scenario_Export, then explains where it looked.

rdp.comment: Live SystemTrack stream. Change the endpoint and the timeouts here rather than in the Python source; --rdp-port and --no-rdp override at start-up. retry_bind_s: how often the receiver retries while the port is unavailable.

live.comment: World clock follows the newest packet time while packets arrive.

audio.comment: Aircraft background ambience while the 3D view is on screen. Represents no data.

logging.comment: Rotating file log in logs/. level: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING or ERROR.
